name: muldhon-client
//: vite, the react plugin, tailwind, postcss and autoprefixer are runtime dependencies here on purpose, not devDependencies. npm skips devDependencies whenever NODE_ENV=production, which is how a Vercel build ends with 'sh: line 1: vite: command not found' — the build tool was never installed. Keeping them in dependencies means the build works whatever NODE_ENV the host sets. They are build-time only and never ship in the bundle.
